notes: Box: the Presidio's edge beside Presidio Terrace and the hatched blocks of Clay/Washington/Jackson (Laurel Heights), chosen to teach open land against a street and a road drawn through open land. Moved from the suggested x 1792-2816, y 2816-3840 to x 1705-2729, y 2630-3654. This keeps out the OFFICERS QUARTERS lettering and building marks (x 2683+, y 3670+), the RESERVOIR outline (x 2737-2860, y 2750-2893: an outlined structure in open land whose kind would be a guess), Julius Kahn Playground and the street ends left open at the sheet join (y 3790+). About 53% of the box is open land (Presidio), 35% blocks, 12% street. FOR THE OWNER TO RULE ON: (1) The Presidio edge is a strip about 15 px wide from (2075,2630) to (2290,3654). Across it: the blocks' own side line, a 2-3 px paper gap, a thin partly dashed line, about 6-7 px of paper, then an outer line. Read as a two-line road (West Pacific Avenue inside the Presidio wall), with the thin dashed line as the Presidio boundary inside it. The reason: at the Arguello gate (2205-2230, 3275-3330) the winding road's two lines turn into the strip's outer line in both directions, which is how a road junction is drawn. The strip is seeded street at (2085,2640), (2092,2680), (2130,2880), (2181,3150), (2239,3450) and (2268,3600). So NO block here faces open land directly: every block side meets the strip, and the open land meets the strip's outer line. If the strip is instead the Presidio wall (two lines) and not a road, blocks 1352, 1353, 1354, 1356, 967 and 968 face open land along it, and the strip should become open land. (2) The thin dashed boundary line is labelled street where it stands free of the block line. Where it touches the block line it is labelled block, mostly near the gate: 1356's corner fingers at 2190-2215, 3240-3295 and 967's hook at 2195-2212, 3290-3320. (3) The winding line through the Presidio is two lines about 8 px apart: a road, seeded street at (2420,3368). It runs from the gate (2215,3330) by (2420,3368) and (2600,3220) to the box's east side. It forks at (2683,3121), and both branches are seeded street, at (2715,3092) and (2715,3126). The land between the branches is its own small open area (2715,3110). (4) The dash-dot line in open land (2125,2828)-(2415,2630), the Hospital Reserve line, is left inside the open area with no edge. (5) Presidio Terrace: the loop drawn with an outer wavy line and an inner ring is the private street, seeded at (2078,3089) and (1959,3120). The small ovals in its four lobes and the PRESIDIO letters are labelled street. Its stem (2036-2048, 3200-3272) is closed at its foot by a short bar at y 3271-3273. A limit cuts the bar at x 2041, so its halves go to 1358 and 1356. Inside the ring, block 1357 is crossed by paths drawn as two lines that meet in a small triangle (about 2000-2110, 3095-3190). They join the loop through the ring and are labelled street. The TERRACE letters touch the ring and are labelled part of 1357. The final E also touched the loop's outer line, so a limit cuts through its middle (2056-2070, 3191). (6) Blocks 1355 (1865-1907, 3020-3077), 1360 (1865-1905, 3077-3165) and 1359 (1865-1900, 3190-3280) carry their own numbers, so each is a block. They share lines with 1354 and with the hatched land, and those lines are stroked: 1354 | 1355 and 1356 along y 3019-3036; 1355 and 1360 | 1356 along x 1902-1908; 1355 | 1360 along y 3077; 1359 | 1358 along x 1898-1899. The hatched land around the loop is read as two blocks: 1356 (north and east, numbered at 2155,3130) and 1358 (south-west, numbered at 1935,3205). They are split by a narrow path drawn as two converging lines, from the street stub between 1360 and 1359 to the loop. The path is too narrow to read as paper, so it is traced as a stroke (1896,3167)-(1957,3153). Lot lines inside 1014, 1016, 1355, 1356, 1358 and 1359 are left inside their blocks. (7) Two street ends are closed by the strip's line: 1353/1354 (2100-2122, 2836) and 967/968 (2225-2251, 3512). In each, the line touches both blocks' corners, and one limit along the street's middle cuts it so each half stays with its block. The street between 1352 and 1353 is closed by its own line at x 2077, 8 px short of the strip. The 8 px of land beyond it joins 1352 to 1353 in the print, and the limit (2068-2100, 2721) splits it between them. (8) A gap in 1352's west line at (1866,2668) is closed by a stroke. Strokes also close one-px gaps in the outlines around the open land: the strip's outer line at (2128,2845), (2201,3232) and (2218,3277); the winding road at (2545,3355), (2603,3211) and (2601,3231); the fork at (2711,3100). (9) Dimension lettering that touches a block's side is labelled part of the block: on 1014 at 1820-1832, 3395-3430; on 990 at 2063-2075, 3395-3440; on 1359's top at 1870-1905, 3180-3190. (10) The leak check finds street inside three block outlines, and all three are real streets: the loop inside 1356's, the walks inside 1357's, and the loop's south-west part inside 1358's. It also lists two 1-2 px rows left over by straightening, on 1354's north side and on 1352's top row at the box edge.
